design.balance_guarantee: Any complete block (24 runs) is perfectly balanced across all 4 arms x 6 tasks.
design.quota_robustness: If failure at run 49, blocks 1-2 (48 runs, 12 per arm) are analyzable independently.

arms.ABS: Target fact absent from all channels.
arms.VIS: Target fact in visible text paragraph (v0-baseline pattern).
arms.ARIA: Target fact in aria-label attribute (v2-aria pattern).
arms.DATA-CFG: Target fact in data-* attribute WITH runner patch to include_attributes.

verifier_requirements: T3: Use cart_exact_match (length==1 AND sku==wh-002) — already in task-definitions.json v2 but legacy verifier.py does not enforce it.
T4: Remove unconditional partial credit; require window.__orderConfirmed__===true AND lastOrder.items contains mse-001.
T5: Add pre-run JS assertion that localStorage cart contains wh-001 before agent launches.
All retrieval tasks: Replace naive substring match with regex word-boundary match and require match only in structured final_result field, not in full agent reasoning text.
execution_safeguards: Hard quota guard: abort experiment after 3 consecutive 429 errors.
Per-run timeout: 120s hard limit to prevent single run consuming disproportionate budget.
Cache disable: CDP Network.setCacheDisabled(True) + context.clear_cookies() between runs.
Pre-run cart state assertion: verify window.__cart__ is empty (T1-T4,T6) or contains wh-001 (T5) before agent launch.
use_vision=False for all runs (eliminates vision confound for VIS arm).
primary_outcome: Binary task success rate per arm (0/1); Fisher exact test for pairwise arm comparisons; Bonferroni correction for 6 pairwise tests (alpha_adjusted=0.0083).
known_blockers: v1-jsonld arm BLOCKED by DISABLED_ELEMENTS — must be redesigned or dropped.
v3-data-attrs requires runner patch to DEFAULT_INCLUDE_ATTRIBUTES to be operational.
use_vision must be set to False to eliminate vision confound.
Legacy verifier.py T3/T4/T5 flaws must be corrected before any new experiment.
